ideas.title: The Impact of Government Funding Freezes on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: Investigate how government funding freezes affect programs for low-income families and potential fraud in these programs.
ideas.angle: Social impact and potential financial mismanagement
questions: How do funding freezes impact low-income families?
What are the signs of potential fraud in these programs?
ideas.insight: Understanding the human impact and potential for fraud in government programs can reveal systemic issues.

ideas.title: The Role of Private Entities in Healthcare Fraud
ideas.description: Explore the involvement of private companies in healthcare fraud schemes and their impact on public programs.
questions: What are common schemes used by private entities in healthcare fraud?
How do these schemes affect public healthcare programs?
ideas.insight: Analyzing data on healthcare fraud can uncover patterns and entities involved in these schemes.
